name: ai.transept/transept
title: Transept
description: Translate documents with glossaries, style guides and translation memory; run and read back jobs.

tools.name: me_get
tools.description: The account this API key belongs to, the key in use, its scopes, and the credit balance available to spend.

tools.name: project_list
tools.description: List projects you can file documents into.

tools.name: project_create
tools.description: Create a project (pass team_id for a team project; parent_id for a sub-project of a top-level project — same owner, one level deep).

team_id.description: Team id (team_id in project_list rows) to create a team project; omit for a personal one.

parent_id.description: Id of a top-level project to nest this one under (one level deep).

tools.name: document_list
tools.description: List documents, newest first. One row per language version; siblings share language_group_id.

project_id.description: Only documents filed in this project (id from project_list).

search.description: Text to match in document titles.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

tools.name: document_get
tools.description: Document metadata + its language group.

document_id.description: Id of one language version of a document (from document_list or document_create).

tools.name: document_create
tools.description: Create a document from inline text/markdown/html and fan out target languages.

content.description: The source text, in the format named by content_type.

source_language.description: Language of the content, e.g. "en"; detected from the text when omitted.

target_languages.description: More target languages, each a sibling version: language codes, e.g. ["de", "fr"].

project_id.description: Project to file the document in (id from project_list).

glossary_ids.description: Glossary ids (from glossary_list) to apply to the translation.

styleguide_version_ids.description: Style-guide VERSION ids (active_version_id from styleguide_list) to apply.

tools.name: document_update
tools.description: Update document metadata (title / category / project filing).

document_id.description: Id of one language version of a document (from document_list or document_create).

document_category.description: Category that tunes the prompts: general_document, legal, marketing or technical.

project_id.description: Project to move the document into (id from project_list).

tools.name: document_delete
tools.description: Delete ONE language version of a document.

document_id.description: Id of one language version of a document (from document_list or document_create).

tools.name: document_add_languages
tools.description: Add target-language sibling versions to a document (grows its language group). Idempotent — languages already in the group are skipped.

document_id.description: Id of one language version of a document (from document_list or document_create).

target_languages.description: Languages to add: language codes, e.g. ["de", "fr"].

tools.name: document_content_get
tools.description: Read content as json | markdown | html | strings (binary formats: use the REST content endpoint).

document_id.description: Id of one language version of a document (from document_list or document_create).

format.description: json (default: blocks with ids and translations, what the edit tools need), markdown, html, or strings (key-value corpora).

tools.name: document_attach_resources
tools.description: Attach/detach glossaries + style-guide versions ([] = detach all of that kind).

document_id.description: Id of one language version of a document (from document_list or document_create).

glossary_ids.description: The full list of glossary ids to attach (replaces the current list; [] detaches all; omit to leave unchanged).

styleguide_version_ids.description: The full list of style-guide VERSION ids to attach (replaces the current list; [] detaches all; omit to leave unchanged).

tools.name: document_resync_source
tools.description: Re-parse the document from its STORED source file and re-align blocks (unchanged blocks keep translations). The file owns sources: block_update edits are NOT in the file, so a resync overwrites them — resync when the source file changed, not after block edits.

document_id.description: Id of one language version of a document (from document_list or document_create).

tools.name: strings_import
tools.description: Import a Transept Strings corpus (.tstrings.json shape). Locales: explicit params win; with none named the corpus header target_locales apply (no locales anywhere → sync no_target_languages). A single-locale import is ONE version row carrying the corpus (language_group_id null until more locales join). Async: returns processing_job_id — poll processing_job_get. Translations the corpus carries land active and bill nothing.

document.description: The .tstrings.json corpus inline, e.g. {"format":"transept-strings","version":1,"source_locale":"en","units":[{"id":"auth.title","source":"Sign in"}]}. A unit may carry targets ({"de":"Anmelden"}), which land unbilled.

target_language.description: The master version’s target language: a language code, e.g. "de" or "zh".

target_languages.description: Languages to produce, one version each: language codes, e.g. ["de", "fr"].

use_target_locales.description: With no languages passed, use the corpus header’s target_locales.

project_id.description: Project to file the document in (id from project_list).

document_category.description: Category that tunes the prompts: general_document, legal, marketing or technical.

tools.name: strings_reimport
tools.description: Re-submit the WHOLE current corpus against an existing master: the server diffs by unit id and answers with {units, versions[], delta_block_ids} — pass delta_block_ids VERBATIM as group_run_start.block_ids to run only the delta. Unchanged units keep their translations. Synchronous, bills nothing.

document_id.description: The master document the corpus was first imported as.

document.description: The WHOLE current .tstrings.json corpus inline (same shape as strings_import). Units missing from it are removed.

overwrite_targets.description: Let the corpus’s targets overwrite translations Transept already holds for changed units (default false).

tools.name: block_update
tools.description: Edit a block's SOURCE content (Slate JSON). Note: edits live on the block, not in the stored source file — a later document_resync_source re-parses the file and overwrites them.

block_id.description: Block id (blocks[].id in document_content_get, format json).

original_content.description: The new source content as Slate JSON: an array of element nodes, e.g. [{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":"Hello"}]}]. Read the current value with document_content_get (format json).

block_type.description: Block type, e.g. paragraph, heading_1, bulleted_list; omit to keep the current one.

tools.name: block_translation_update
tools.description: Edit a translation (Slate JSON); it stays active and feeds TM.

translation_id.description: Translation id (translation.id inside blocks in document_content_get, format json).

translated_content.description: The new translation as Slate JSON: an array of element nodes, e.g. [{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":"Hello"}]}]. Read the current value with document_content_get (format json).

tools.name: processing_job_get
tools.description: Poll an import job — the id returned by strings_import (or a REST file upload / Figma import). Runs are NOT processing jobs: poll those with run_get.

tools.name: workflow_list
tools.description: Saved workflows (ids go into run_start.workflow_id).

tools.name: workflow_template_list
tools.description: Built-in templates (ids go into run_start.template_id).

tools.name: run_estimate
tools.description: Price a run (free, no side effects). Costs are in credits.

document_id.description: The language version to run the workflow over.

workflow_id.description: A saved workflow (id from workflow_list). Pass exactly one of workflow_id or template_id.

template_id.description: A built-in template (id from workflow_template_list). Pass exactly one of workflow_id or template_id.

parallel_mode.description: Large-parallel mode with shared glossary/style-guide passes, for long documents (default false).

updated_only.description: Translate only blocks whose source changed since their current translation; review steps keep full scope (default false).

block_ids.description: Run only these block ids (blocks[].id in document_content_get); omit for the whole document.

tools.name: run_start
tools.description: Start a workflow run. BILLS CREDITS — without confirm:true this only returns the estimate and starts nothing.

document_id.description: The language version to run the workflow over.

workflow_id.description: A saved workflow (id from workflow_list). Pass exactly one of workflow_id or template_id.

template_id.description: A built-in template (id from workflow_template_list). Pass exactly one of workflow_id or template_id.

parallel_mode.description: Large-parallel mode with shared glossary/style-guide passes, for long documents (default false).

updated_only.description: Translate only blocks whose source changed since their current translation; review steps keep full scope (default false).

block_ids.description: Run only these block ids (blocks[].id in document_content_get); omit for the whole document.

confirm.description: true to start and spend credits; omit to get the estimate only.

tools.name: run_get
tools.description: Poll a run: status, progress, and (when gate_pending) the review-gate digest.

job_id.description: Run id (job_id from run_start or run_list).

tools.name: run_list
tools.description: List runs, newest first. Paged like document_list: {data, has_more, next_cursor}.

document_id.description: Only runs over this document version.

status.description: Only runs in this status: queued, processing, completed, failed or cancelled.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

tools.name: run_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a run (idempotent — answers with the resulting status, so an already-terminal run reads as what it already was).

job_id.description: Run id (job_id from run_start or run_list).

tools.name: run_gate_approve
tools.description: Approve a review gate. Continuing downstream steps BILLS CREDITS — without confirm:true this only returns what continuing will cost (up to max_credits) and continues nothing. Omit block_ids to continue over ALL blocks the run processed; pass a subset to continue only those; pass [] to close the gate WITHOUT running (or billing) anything further (no confirm needed). No downstream steps → error no_continuation (use run_gate_acknowledge).

job_id.description: The run whose review gate is pending (gate_pending true in run_get).

block_ids.description: Blocks to continue over: omit for all the run’s blocks, a subset for only those, [] to close the gate without running anything.

confirm.description: true to continue and spend credits; omit to get the price only.

tools.name: run_gate_acknowledge
tools.description: Dismiss a review gate without continuing.

job_id.description: Run id (job_id from run_start or run_list).

tools.name: group_run_estimate
tools.description: Price a multi-language fan-out (free).

document_id.description: Any version in the language group; the group is resolved from it.

workflow_id.description: A saved workflow (id from workflow_list). Pass exactly one of workflow_id or template_id.

template_id.description: A built-in template (id from workflow_template_list). Pass exactly one of workflow_id or template_id.

target_languages.description: Languages to run, e.g. ["de", "fr"], or "all" for every version in the group.

parallel_mode.description: Large-parallel mode for every language, for long documents (default false).

include_untranslated.description: Include versions with no translations yet (default true); set false for a review-only run.

updated_only.description: Per language, translate only blocks whose source changed since their current translation (default false).

block_ids.description: Scope the run: block ids of the master, or a map of document_id → block ids (pass strings_reimport’s delta_block_ids as-is). Omit for whole documents.

tools.name: group_run_start
tools.description: Run a workflow across many languages. BILLS CREDITS — without confirm:true this only returns the estimate.

document_id.description: Any version in the language group; the group is resolved from it.

workflow_id.description: A saved workflow (id from workflow_list). Pass exactly one of workflow_id or template_id.

template_id.description: A built-in template (id from workflow_template_list). Pass exactly one of workflow_id or template_id.

target_languages.description: Languages to run, e.g. ["de", "fr"], or "all" for every version in the group.

parallel_mode.description: Large-parallel mode for every language, for long documents (default false).

include_untranslated.description: Include versions with no translations yet (default true); set false for a review-only run.

updated_only.description: Per language, translate only blocks whose source changed since their current translation (default false).

block_ids.description: Scope the run: block ids of the master, or a map of document_id → block ids (pass strings_reimport’s delta_block_ids as-is). Omit for whole documents.

confirm.description: true to start and spend credits; omit to get the estimate only.

tools.name: group_run_get
tools.description: Poll a group run: rollup + per-language lanes.

group_run_id.description: Multi-language run id (id from group_run_start or group_run_list).

tools.name: group_run_list
tools.description: List group runs, newest first.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

tools.name: group_run_cancel
tools.description: Cancel every still-active lane of a group run.

group_run_id.description: Multi-language run id (id from group_run_start or group_run_list).

tools.name: glossary_list
tools.description: List glossaries (yours + your teams’).

tools.name: glossary_get
tools.description: One glossary with its terms.

tools.name: glossary_create
tools.description: Create a glossary (optionally seed terms).

source_language.description: Language of the source terms: a language code, e.g. "de" or "zh".

primary_target_language.description: Language of the target terms: a language code, e.g. "de" or "zh".

terms.description: Terms to seed it with (up to 2,000).

source_term.description: The term in the source language.

target_term.description: Its translation in the glossary’s primary target language.

do_not_translate.description: Keep the source term verbatim in every translation.

variants.description: Source-side inflections or spellings that count as this term.

forbidden_targets.description: Translations the model must NOT produce.

tools.name: glossary_terms_add
tools.description: Add terms in bulk; the answer is counts.

source_term.description: The term in the source language.

target_term.description: Its translation in the glossary’s primary target language.

do_not_translate.description: Keep the source term verbatim in every translation.

variants.description: Source-side inflections or spellings that count as this term.

forbidden_targets.description: Translations the model must NOT produce.

tools.name: styleguide_list
tools.description: List style guides with their ACTIVE version id (what documents consume).

tools.name: styleguide_get
tools.description: One style guide incl. the active version content.

styleguide_id.description: Style guide id from styleguide_list (not a version id).

tools.name: tm_query
tools.description: Query translation memory (hybrid retrieval; free).

query_text.description: Source-language text to find matches for, e.g. a sentence or paragraph.

source_lang.description: Language of query_text: a language code, e.g. "de" or "zh".

target_lang.description: Language of the translations to return: a language code, e.g. "de" or "zh".

document_id.description: Apply this document’s translation-memory settings (which projects and statuses count).

cross_language.description: Also return matches from other language pairs (default false).

tools.name: tm_import
tools.description: Import a TMX/XLIFF file’s text into translation memory (free; async embeddings).

content.description: The whole TMX or XLIFF file as text.

project_id.description: Project to attribute the entries to (id from project_list).

tools.name: webhook_list
tools.description: List outgoing webhook endpoints (no secrets).

tools.name: webhook_create
tools.description: Register an outgoing webhook. The response carries the signing secret ONCE.

url.description: HTTPS URL Transept will POST signed events to, e.g. "https://example.com/hooks/transept".

events.description: Events to receive: run.completed, run.failed, run.gate_ready, group_run.completed, document.processed, document.processing_failed, ping; ["*"] or omit for all.

tools.name: webhook_delete
tools.description: Delete an outgoing webhook endpoint.
